cohort: 85 full-term asphyxiated neonates diagnosed with HIE
finding: AKI was observed to be a common complication in asphyxiated neonates.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was the mode of delivery in 56.4% of infants admitted to the NICU with HIE, assisted vaginal delivery in 16.5%, emergency cesarean in 22.4% and elective caesarean section in 4.7%.
